answer: To join, a newcomer also harvests a verifiable work receipt from an existing orchard of tasks, and reputation accrues only after an ivory-tier audit confirms the receipt. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit recorded on the shared ledge; identity keys are then derived from that stake, so spinning up fake personas costs real capital at risk. A sock-puppet that forks thousands of keys must fund every bond and pass every audit, making mass identity creation economically ruinous while honest single-key agents pay once. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
